proposed_capability: Compose the existing process-bound semantic save selector, per-Sim restock controller and responder handoff in one opt-in lab launch.
player_save_control_impact: Retain lab authorization and production policy. Observe menu without effects. Bind restock to the chosen slot and catalog roster before buying, and preserve an already loaded session.
expected_outcome: The named dev target reaches the existing restock controller followed by one independently observed native responder decision.
negative_tests: Stale catalog, loaded existing session, wrong slot or roster, absent binding and unrecorded dispatch cannot advance effects.
rollback_path: Revert this isolated integration. No Windows host or Sims files changed by offline implementation.
unresolved_unknowns: Installed Windows exact-build catalog and restock binding and live outcome.
